name: Axis Meridian Corporate Rain Shell
description:
A clean, corporate-issue waterproof shell in charcoal grey with a subtle herringbone texture in the fabric weave, a single chest pocket, and a packable hood that stows into the collar. The Axis Meridian logo — a small geometric mark — appears at the left chest in tonal embroidery. This is the jacket you receive on your first week at an Axis Meridian subsidiary, along with your access card and your orientation packet. It's not exciting. It's not meant to be.

The shell is technically competent — fully seam-sealed, breathable membrane, adjustable cuffs — and utterly anonymous. It marks you as an Axis employee to other Axis employees and as a mid-corporate drone to everyone else. People wear it because it's free and it works. Some people wear it for years after leaving the company because it's still the best rain jacket they own and they've stopped caring what the logo says.
what_it_says: You work for a corporation, or you used to. You're practical about it. The jacket works.
worn_by: anyone who received one and kept it
story_hooks: A character finds an Axis Meridian rain shell in their apartment that doesn't belong to them — the access card sewn into the inner pocket still works on a door they've never tried to open.

A flood of Axis Meridian shells has appeared on Shelf-district secondhand markets, all from the same production run — someone liquidated an entire warehouse's worth, and Axis wants to know who and why.
Wearing this jacket gets a character waved through an Axis checkpoint without scanning — the guard assumes they're staff. The question is how deep they can go before someone looks closer.
